method: For every statement this site has labelled invented, fabricated, mutated, drifted or superseded in an AI answer, search the full git history of the site for that statement (value and context) in anything we published before the observation date. If our own record contained it, the label is wrong.
scope: September 2026 benchmark grades carrying FABRICATED_SUPPORT or CORRECTION_REGRESSION, and q9 TEMPORAL_DRIFT
